description: Source code for Kubernetes submission operations in Apache Spark, including classes for killing applications, listing status, and executing commands on pods within the Kubernetes environment.

classes.name: K8sSubmitOp
classes.description: Sealed trait defining operations for submitting to Kubernetes pods, with methods for executing on individual pods or groups of pods.

classes.name: KillApplication
classes.description: Implementation of K8sSubmitOp to kill applications/pods in Kubernetes, with support for grace period.

classes.name: ListStatus
classes.description: Implementation of K8sSubmitOp to list status of applications/pods in Kubernetes.

classes.name: K8SSparkSubmitOperation
classes.description: Main class extending SparkSubmitOperation to handle Kubernetes-specific submission commands, including kill and status, with support for glob patterns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a submission operation (kill or list status) on specified pods or groups based on submission ID.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Submits a request to kill a specific submission ID.

methods.name: printSubmissionStatus
methods.description: Prints the status of a specific submission ID.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the master URL corresponds to a Kubernetes environment.

methods.name: getGracePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the grace period setting from SparkConf for Kubernetes operations.

methods.name: isGlob
methods.description: Determines if a given name pattern is a glob pattern (ends with '*').
